functions.name: Market

insights.t: With 112 more apartments, nearby stock rises to 472 units, about 14 months of sales
Base rate sits 1% below the nearby average of ₹ 9,900 /sqft
Nearby rates rose about 2% a quarter, so three-month-old prices may be low

flags.t: April 2026 guidance value not confirmed as gazetted
Two of six rates are portal asking prices
Floor rise and parking charge still assumed

reports: Price sheet and payment plan note
sent: Absorption and revenue assumptions to Finance

mustHave: Price on carpet area (RERA s.2(k)); super built-up area is not a legal basis.
Stamp duty runs on the higher of price and guidance value; check before quoting.
Price over 10% below stamp value triggers tax: developer s.53, buyer s.92 (2025 Act).
GST sits on top: 5% residential, 1% affordable, no input credit (commercial rate unconfirmed).
Guidance values: April 2026 revision announced; confirm it is gazetted before quoting duty.

mustHave: No advance above 10% of cost without a registered agreement for sale (RERA s.13).
Use the Annexure-A agreement format (Karnataka rule 8A, since 12 June 2020).
Every ad shows K-RERA number, website and QR code (s.11(2); order 19 August 2023).
Agents need K-RERA registration (s.9); at ₹20 lakh turnover they also report under PMLA.
No mortgage on a unit after its agreement for sale (s.11(4)(h)); lender NOC first.

Dues ageing with flags for likely defaults

reports: Buyer ledger and statement of account

Payment reminder, then interest notice, before any cancellation notice
Receipt, TDS credit confirmation and refund letters

mustHave: Deposit 70% of buyer receipts, net of GST and pass-throughs, in the RERA account.
Buyer deducts 1% TDS if price or stamp value is ₹50 lakh or more.
Delay interest is one rate both ways: SBI highest MCLR plus 2%, now 10.80%.
Forfeiture on buyer cancellation is capped near 10% of base price; refund the rest.
GST: tax invoice on each demand, receipt voucher on each advance (CGST Act s.31).

certified: Occupancy certificate: local planning authority (GBA city corporation in Bengaluru); RERA s.11(4)(b), s.17(1)
Fire clearance and lift licence: Karnataka Fire and Emergency Services; Chief Inspector of Lifts (2012 Act)
As-built carpet area per unit: project architect, against RERA s.2(k) before final price adjustment
sent: Possession offer with OC copy and final account

mustHave: Possession only after the OC; buyer takes it within 2 months of OC (s.19(10)).
Conveyance within 3 months of OC; documents to association within 30 days (s.17).
Five-year defect liability from possession; fix within 30 days, free of charge (s.14(3)).
Delay interest runs each month to possession (s.18(1)); undertakings cannot waive rights (rule 8A).
Promoter pays outgoings and runs essential services until the association takes over (s.11(4)(d), (g)).
